stories.title: Why Sun Pharma Advanced Research shares surge 11% despite weak sentiments on D-Street; what's boosting medical stock?
stories.dek: The pharma stock opened in green at ₹198.50 apiece on the NSE today, as compared to the previous close of ₹197.03 on Sunday's Muhurat Trading and touched an intraday high of ₹219.49 on 9 November.

stories.title: Tech firms claw back some losses after midterms rout, eyes on Nvidia
stories.dek: Tech firms rose Monday to claw back some of last week's painful losses fuelled by AI regulation worries, though traders were keeping a wary eye on a probe into Nvidia boss Jensen Huang amid claims of an affair with a Chinese spy.

stories.title: FSSAI seizes food products worth Rs 81.8 crore, suspends over 1,100 licences in nationwide drive
stories.dek: FSSAI seized 3,279.57 metric tonnes of food products worth an estimated Rs 81.80 crore and suspended 1,133 licences during a nationwide inspection drive covering 56,431 establishments between September 1 and November 5.

stories.title: Indian bonds drift with oil; inflation data in focus
stories.dek: Indian government bonds exhibited limited movement today as oil prices showed signs of stabilization. Investors are remaining cautious, especially with inflation data from both the United States and India on the horizon.

stories.title: Why Nvidia shares dropped 4% in overnight trade and what analysts warn can trigger a bloodbath?
stories.dek: Nvidia shares dropped over 4% after CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged an affair with Alice Huang. Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice, a Chinese national, raised security concerns following intelligence reports.

stories.title: 47% rally in one month! Infra stock under ₹100 inches close to 52-week high after announcement of Q2 Results 2026 date
stories.dek: Highway Infrastructure shares rose nearly 1.18% in Monday's intraday trade ahead of a board meeting scheduled for November 14. Directors will review half-year and quarterly results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

stories.title: HFCL shares locked in 5% lower circuit, down 21% in a month despite record Q2 profit: What lies ahead?
stories.dek: HFCL shares hit the 5% lower circuit despite record Q2 FY27 results, with net profit rising to ₹394.22 crore and revenue more than doubling.

stories.title: Nvidia stock in focus: 3 key risks after Jensen Huang probe

stories.title: Nuvama Wealth Management Q2 Results: Profit rises 19% YoY to Rs 304 crore
stories.dek: Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd achieved a consolidated net profit of Rs 303.5 crore for Q2 FY27. The company saw a revenue increase of 20.35% to Rs 1,366 crore for the same quarter. Client assets reached Rs 5.5 lakh crore, reflecting a 25% year-on-year growth.

stories.title: Gold, silver prices may sway with US-Iran tensions
stories.dek: As the US-Iran conflict and crude oil pricing remain in focus, bullion prices are set to encounter downward pressure. Key economic data releases from China, the US, Germany, Japan, and India will significantly impact inflation and interest rate expectations.

stories.title: Oil falls on open as Trump says fresh Iran attacks 'unlikely'
stories.dek: Oil prices fell at the start of the week as uncertainties regarding military actions persist. US President Donald Trump suggested that further attacks on Iran are unlikely while diplomatic talks are ongoing.

stories.title: Iraq reaches US understanding to resume oil exports through Strait of Hormuz, says foreign minister
stories.dek: Iraq has reached an understanding with the US to allow its oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz using a shipping lane near Oman, Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein said. Iraq's losses from the Iran war and disruptions to oil shipments have reached $60 billion.

stories.title: Airlines go premium as demand for business-class seats outpaces economy
stories.dek: Since 2020, airlines have increased the number of premium seats significantly to meet growing consumer demand. Airlines are adopting strategies to enhance premium offerings, including gourmet meals and exclusive lounges.

stories.title: Karnataka, Uber discuss passenger safety, regulatory issues and urban transport
stories.dek: Karnataka Minister Priyank Kharge recently met with the Uber India Public Policy team to discuss urban mobility. The discussions emphasized passenger safety, regulatory issues, and improvements in urban commuting services.
